patch_description:
A completely different, more parameter-efficient, symmetry-aware ansatz that preserves the fixed training setup but reorganizes the trainable parameters to improve generalization and convergence. The new ANSATZ_SPEC uses:
- a 3-way pre-RZ scheme (corners, edges, center) with shared parameters to exploit tic-tac-toe rotational symmetry
- a single global RY parameter applied to all qubits (dramatically reducing parameter count)
- ring entanglement on the outer perimeter via alternating CRX gates (two ring parameters) to capture rotational structure with few parameters
- center-to-edge hub entanglement using two shared parameters (hub_crx, hub_cry)
- symmetric post-RZ gates mirroring the pre-layer

This design reduces the per-block parameter count (to 11 keys) and emphasizes symmetry, which typically improves generalization and speeds up convergence in Adam-driven training while keeping the problem structure intact. It maintains the same inputs/outputs and fixed training loop, data, and feature map.
